locations.note: Gordon Fitzpatrick hires Tex to find his friend Thomas Malloy; the trail runs through the Ritz, the Fuchsia Flamingo club and NSA headquarters Autotech to a warehouse where Malloy is killed.
Following Malloy's clues, Tex enters the deserted Roswell research complex, seals the alien entity still lurking there in a containment pod and takes the alien power cell from the security room.

routes.name: Tex Murphy
routes.note: From the hunt for Malloy in San Francisco to Roswell and back to the office where the Pandora Device is assembled.
